Buffering? Start with these simple checks.

A structured troubleshooting checklist for buffering, from Wi-Fi and device checks to useful support information.

By Lumina Stream editorial20 November 20262 min read

In this guide

Find out how wide the problem isCheck the connection near the screenGive the player a clean startSend support something usefulAll journal articles
The short answer

First check whether the problem affects one channel or every app. Then test your home network, restart the player and try a lower quality setting if available.

Find out how wide the problem is

Try another channel, then another streaming app on the same device. If only one channel fails, the source may be the issue. If every app struggles, your device or network may need attention. A speed test is one signal, not a complete diagnosis.

Record the affected channel, time and what the player does. A frozen picture, repeated loading spinner and login error can point to different causes.

Check the connection near the screen

A fast internet plan does not guarantee a strong Wi-Fi signal beside your television. Walls, distance, interference and other household traffic can affect the connection. Test near the device rather than only next to the router.

Where your hardware supports it, compare a wired Ethernet connection. Pause other large downloads during the test. Change one variable at a time so you can see whether it helps.

Give the player a clean start

Close and reopen the player. If the problem continues, restart the device using its normal restart option. Check the official store for updates. Avoid clearing account data unless you have the connection details needed to sign back in.

If a lower playback quality is available, use it for a comparison. Improvement at a lower quality suggests the connection or device may be struggling with the original stream, but it is not proof of a single cause.

Send support something useful

Include your device model, player, affected stream, approximate time and whether other apps work. Explain which tests you have already tried. That helps avoid repeating the same steps.

Never send a full payment card number, player account password or unredacted playlist in a public message. Support should explain any account information it needs and provide a suitable private channel.

Your next useful step.

Check your device, make a viewing list and compare the full plan terms before you pay. Use the focused guides below to keep the next step simple.
